The right square similarly passes through the right figure.
Both squares end up overlapping at the central hole. Let me execute RIGHT ×3, UP ×6 and check the result. Actually, let me do it in two batches so I can observe: first RIGHT ×3 (both squares to cols 29-33, rows 44-48 — overlapping at the bottom of the central gap!). Wait: after RIGHT ×3, left is at cols 29-33, right is at cols 29-33, both at rows 44-48. They overlap at the bottom of the central gap (rows 44-48, cols 29-33). Then UP ×6 moves them to the top hole.
